credits.intro: Every dataset, partner dataset, tool and library ITZA uses, with its license and citation. This list is built into the app and works offline.
credits.si.title: How ITZA uses SI
credits.si.assistant: The assistant reads your question and shows a ready-made answer layout. It rephrases and routes; it does not do the science.
credits.si.model: A LightGBM stress model, trained on NASA data, estimates how stressed a crop would have been. Its outputs are labeled as model estimates.
credits.si.never: SI never states a number that ITZA's engine did not compute or retrieve. Without SI, the assistant falls back to fixed templates.
credits.si.built: SI coding tools helped write parts of the code and documentation. The team reviewed and tested that work. SI was not used to come up with the idea.
credits.role.gpm_imerg_late_daily: Daily rain for recent days, before the final product is ready
credits.role.hls_vi: 30 m greenness (NDVI) history of the field
credits.role.nasa_power_daily: Daily weather: temperature, humidity, wind, sunlight
credits.role.cmr: Checks which satellite data exist for a place
credits.role.soilgrids: Soil texture, organic carbon, pH and water-holding capacity
credits.role.ssurgo: US soil survey properties, root-zone water capacity and drainage
